decision.reason: The only evidence is a single changelog line, [ev-6112f6912c4e]. It says golangci-lint autofixes were run on main and links to PR #6592. It doesn't name any changed component, API, flag, default or behaviour, and it doesn't say whether the automated fixes changed runtime behaviour. Calling the change behaviour-neutral or informational would rest on general assumptions about linting, not on the evidence. To write the subject, change and applicability aspects, we would need the PR's diff or description showing what code changed and that no shipped behaviour changed.
